name: prompt-idler
description: Keep Windows awake during detected GitHub Copilot activity, with a manual timer fallback.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm test && npm run build

commands.title: Prompt Idler: Disable and Release Wake Requests
Prompt Idler: Keep Awake for 30 Minutes
Prompt Idler: Stop Manual Keep Awake

promptIdler.enabled.description: Enable automatic detection and manual keep-awake controls on this computer. Disabling releases all wake requests.

promptIdler.keepDisplayOn.description: Also prevent idle display sleep while keeping Windows awake. Does not bypass screen locking or explicit sleep.

promptIdler.staleRequestTimeoutMinutes.description: Release a detected request if its completion is not observed within this many minutes. Long-running work may need a higher value.
